sections.heading: A smarter way to earn back up to 100% of your premium by staying consistent with your health.
sections.text:
At Activ Yuva, we believe health is not about doing one thing perfectly. It’s about how you eat, how you move, and how well you recover.
HealthReturns™ is our way of turning these everyday healthy habits into real value. FitForward is the system that ensures you’re rewarded for your holistic health journey.

sections.heading: Rewarding sleep and recovery
sections.text:
If you
record 7–8 hours of sleep,
for at least 21 days in a month,
you earn a 15% booster on the HealthReturns™ you’ve earned that month.

sections.heading: Important Note:
sections.text:
• EAT & HEAL boosters unlock only after you achieve a minimum of 4 Active Dayz™.
• You will not be eligible to earn EAT & HEAL boosters in case you have earned 23 or more Active Dayz™ in a month
How you can use your HealthReturns™
Your HealthReturns™ are rewards which can be used for
Immediate health needs
